description: GATING. Drive the P0-b Unsloth harness on an ephemeral RunPod B200 (192GB) THROUGH bellhop (check in -> run -> pull ckpt -> check out). Verify Unsloth+Qwen3-14B on Blackwell (CUDA/triton), 14B FFT fits 192GB with chosen optimizer (fp32 AdamW ~170GB; 8-bit/paged for headroom), ckpt round-trips to scimt.eval.sample. Fallback: plain HF Trainer FFT on same pod. EXIT: 1-step 14B FFT on a B200 pod, ckpt round-trips, scimt.eval.sample scores it.
title: P0-c: run Unsloth harness on a B200 via bellhop (GATING)
